Lean renders this as the quantifier nesting of exists_ordered_prepared_continuation, whose prefix reproduces the tail of (B.40) stage for stage, with the first stage in exists_fixed_schedule and the (B_k) stage in ordered_seed_bounds. The trailing universal quantifier over the requested order J gives smallness at every finite order, which is stronger than the paper needs. The remark's closing clause — finite (not small) bounds at every other fixed order, radial cutoff derivatives possibly carrying inverse powers of the final widths — has no quantitative counterpart; only C^∞ smoothness of the cutoff was found.
